buy(uint256,address,uint8,uint256).notice: Buy `shares` of Early or Late for `account`. Platform pays USDC.

createMarket(string,string,string,uint64.notice: Open LMSR market; pulls b*ln(2) USDC subsidy from platform.

outcomeFromArrival(uint64,uint64).notice: Pure resolution rule: on or before frozen ETA → Early; strictly after → Late.

platform().notice: Platform signer — sole operator for create / buy / sell / resolve.

priceEarly(uint256).notice: Marginal Early price in WAD (1e18 = 100%). After resolve: 1e18 or 0.

quoteBuy(uint256,uint8,uint256).notice: Quote USDC cost to buy `shares` without executing.

quoteSell(uint256,uint8,uint256).notice: Quote USDC proceeds to sell `shares` without executing.

resolveMarket(uint256,uint8).notice: Resolve to Early or Late only. Emits actualArrivalUnix=0 when unknown.

resolveMarketFromArrival(uint256,uint64).notice: Resolve from actual arrival vs frozen ETA (exact-on-time → Early).
